navigation_model: Module navigator remains TRACE SEARCH; opening this surface does not create a private shell.

states.default: Render Trace Search content using the selected asset/resource and current capabilities.
states.loading: Keep shell/selection visible; show bounded loading state; disable actions that require completed data.
states.empty: Explain what is absent and provide only the valid create/select/configure action.
states.error: Show persistent diagnostic and recovery action; do not discard authored state.
states.permission: Show permission denied distinctly from unsupported/unavailable provider capability.
states.disconnected_or_stale: Preserve last safe result as visibly stale where policy permits; disable live mutations.

keyboard: Use standard region traversal; arrows for tree/grid; Enter activates; Space toggles/selects where conventional; Shift+F10/context-menu key opens semantic actions; no new global shortcut without registry update.
pointer: Single click selects; drag/drop only for documented semantic payload/target; splitters use standard hit target; no destructive mutation on drop.
persistence: Authored state persists through Project/Asset service with optimistic revision; runtime result references are separate; layout is device-local.
multi_window: May detach only through ToolRegistry/WorkspaceHost capability; detached instance uses the same authoritative asset/resource state.
accessibility: Critical content has text/tree/table alternative; visible focus; non-drag alternative; profile-compatible.
